points.quote: Create the identifier with `createDecorator<IFoo>('fooService')` (`instantiation.ts:109`). By convention the const and the interface share the name
When a class is created with `instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, 'arg')`, the container reads that metadata and supplies the services
Services in `workbench/services/**` are registered through `registerSingleton` in `*.contribution.ts` or `workbench.common.main.ts`.
